title: Master's Program in China Studies
about: Master's program in China Studies at the Yenching Academy of Peking University in Beijing. Applications for the September 2027 intake are open to international applicants and applicants from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan.
requirements: Students or alumni of a Partner University must first go through their home university's internal selection process
card_alt: Card for the Master's Program in China Studies at Yenching Academy of Peking University in Beijing, China, application deadline 30 Nov 2026. The photo shows a painted wooden gateway with red lanterns in a Chinese ancient town (Shuhe/Donghe, Lijiang), used as a general China image.
